نصطبن (form VIII)
# نَصْطَبِنُ (naṣṭabinu) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# نُصْطَبَنُ (nuṣṭabanu) /nusˤ.tˤa.ba.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# نَصْطَبِنَ (naṣṭabina) /nasˤ.tˤa.bi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَبَنَ (iṣṭabana)
# نُصْطَبَنَ (nuṣṭabana) /nusˤ.tˤa.
